stock.description: Vala Inc. is a financial entity focused on credit card services. The firm provides solutions for consolidating the management of various credit cards from diverse banks, simplifies the process of applying for new cards, and streamlines credit card bill payments. Founded by Hai Tao Sun, Vala Inc. maintains its headquarters in Hangzhou, China.
